notes.title: ver1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
All You Need is Help, ver1.1.1 Update

・Added a reset button to address issues when placing furniture
・Corrected some text
・Other bug fixed and improvement.

notes.title: Free Trial Version Now Available on Steam
notes.notes:
Free Trial Features:
Online multiplayer matching is fully available and play time is unlimited
Certain functions, such as gacha, room expansion, area unlocking, character selection and local multiplayer are not available.

notes.title: ver1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
All You Need is Help, ver1.0.3 Update

・Fixed an issue where the game would crash when instruments were played at certain times.
・Fixed a crash issue occurring when earning stamps.
・Fixed a bug related to room expansion.
・Fixed an issue where players could not proceed from the title screen on XCloud.
Other bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: ver1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
"All You Need is Help" ver1.0.2 Update

・Improved matchmaking
・Players joining via local multiplayer will now receive coins
・Fixed various crashes during gameplay
・Other bug fixes
